vip.tier: Binance VIP 3: assumes >= 20,000,000 USD 30-day spot volume (a 10M USD book reset monthly clears it on its own) and >= 100 BNB held; standard taker rates, BNB fee discount not modelled; one level for both legs (VIP level applies to all Binance products)

tiers_note: Each tier is [notional upper bound USD, maintenance rate, maintenance amount USD]; maintenance = rate x notional - amount. The last bound is null (no upper bound): Binance caps BTCUSDT at 1.8e9 USD notional (bracketNotionalCap of tier 12), which this snapshot does not model.
tiers_source: riskBrackets of the JSON endpoint behind the Leverage & Margin page, symbol BTCUSDT, endpoint updateTime 2025-08-19T06:36:24Z; re-fetched 2026-10-28 and identical (assets/binance_brackets_BTCUSDT_2026-10-28.json). Fees checked 2026-10-28 against the JSON endpoint behind the USD-M fee page (assets/binance_futures_fee_levels_2026-10-28.json: level 0 taker 0.0005, level 3 taker 0.00032) and the spot fee page (Regular user taker 0.100%, VIP 3 taker 0.060%); standard rates, the then-running zero-maker/taker-discount perp promotion ignored. Liquidation clearance fee 1.25% read from the BTCUSDT row of the perpetual trading-rules page on 2026-10-28.
